title: An evaluation case
description: One customer from one split, one scripted conversation from one request family in one language, optional fixtures and faults, and the outcome the oracle expects, per turn (ADR-0005, What a case is). A case names its customer and its messages carry the customer's values, so it is row-level data: cases live under data/evaluation/ and in the evaluation bucket, never in the repository (SEC-03).

case_id.description: Opaque: derived from the set, the generator's seed, and the case's place in the draw, so it says nothing about the customer.

side.description: A held_out case's customer and answers are held out, and its messages too unless phrasing says otherwise; a development case is development throughout (DML-09).

phrasing.description: The side the case's messages come from: its own, or development for a held_out situation that no held-out family fits (ADR-0005, The split). Absent means its own.

group.description: The coverage table's group (ADR-0005, Coverage and size).

situation.description: What the generator drew the case for, such as credit.over_limit; reports count cases by it.

source.description: natural: the customer's own records hold the situation; built: a fixture adds it, and every report labels the case built; harness: the harness produces it; authored: the message carries it.

family_id.description: Null only for a harness case that sends no message.

fixtures.description: Records the snapshot lacks, written to the case's sandbox before its first turn (ADR-0004's overlay).

text.description: An authored message with its slots filled from the case's customer.

id.description: The family message or answer it was filled from: <family_id>/<language>/<n>, or <answer_id>/<language>.

script.description: What the customer says and does. Messages are sent in order, each once the agent waits for nothing; an answer is sent when the agent asks for it, and the customer says it doesn't know when the script holds none (ADR-0005, The scripted customer).

aside.description: Sent once when the agent asks for a detail, before the answer, and answers nothing (POL-06).

typed_yes.description: Typed when the confirm control shows, in place of pressing it (POL-36).

slots.description: The values the messages' slots were filled with, as recorded; the messages state them in the case's formats. An answer states the meant record's values instead.

means.description: The records the customer means, which the oracle reads and the answers were filled from.

actions.description: Harness actions, each before the customer's turn it names (1 is the first).

fault.description: A tool that fails its next calls in the case's sign-in.

decision.description: One request served in a turn, as its decision entry should record it; null request_label for a message with no card request (POL-06).

rules.description: The rules the oracle applied; the grader reports them, and checks none against the record's.

sends.description: What the customer sends this turn: the script's next message, an answer, or a control press.

decisions.description: One per request served, in POL-05's order; the scripted customer reacts to the last.

language.description: The conversation's language each decision records (POL-50; ADR-0005's amendment of 2026-10-02).

facts.description: What the reply must state, by placeholder, in the words and formats ADR-0004's table gives.

withheld.description: Words no event may show the customer, compared without case: those naming a customer status the policy withholds (POL-12), unless one of the customer's cards is in it.

turns.description: Empty only for a harness case that sends no message.

blocked.description: The cards the sandbox holds blocked at the end, by product_id.
